header.name: Execute Cycle Count Scan
header.description:
**Use:** This is to load a count line details based on a serial number that is scanned. This will prompt you if the inventory is not in part of a count.

**Used In:** The execute cycle count screen.

branches.name: Inventory Is Not Part Of This Count

data.messageTransform: "This Inventory was not accounted for in this count. Are you sure it should be included?"
"This inventory is not in the system. Contact a supervisor for more information.."
"This Inventory is expected to be in " & inventory.edges.node.countLineInventories.edges.node.storageUnit.code & ". Are you sure it should be moved to "& $components.Form2.data.storageUnit.code & "?"
